title: Keto Russian Beef Kebabs
description: Tangy and tender Russian dish featuring coriander leaves and infuse-oil, perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together infuse oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika
Add the beef strips to the bowl and marinate for at least 10 minutes
Thread the marinated beef strips onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness
Garnish with chopped coriander leaves and serve immediately
Let the kebabs rest for 2-3 minutes before serving
Serve with a side of cauliflower rice or a green salad for a complete keto meal
